feedback_audit.cb4_qualification: C. briggsae occurs in historical planning; that planning mention is retained as exposure history and is not treated as evidence that no prior use occurred.
feedback_audit.excluded_reason: Their logs contain Matrix::parseFromFile failures; the repaired platypus/sea-urchin products are used instead.
feedback_audit.finding: No per-candidate D inference, calibration, DEV score, or model-selection feedback artifact was found in the candidate preparation tree or the project planning records inspected for this contract.
feedback_audit.interpretation: This closes the available task-feedback audit only. It does not prove absence of pretraining exposure, TE-family homology, or all unpublished use outside the inspected records.

panel_selection.description: For each exact assembly, take the first four report rows in assembly-report order with the accession type used by its FASTA (RefSeq for GCF, GenBank for GCA) and use a centered 1,048,576-bp interval per sequence.

rc_consistency.mapping: project base-pair probabilities first; [s,e) -> [L-e,L-s) by vector reversal

scientific_scope: fixed-D finite external comparator panel; no independent genome-wide accuracy claim
status_denominator: one candidate x four arms; a missing final summary is FAILED

truth.primary_callable_policy: intersect truth and prediction with A/C/G/T before the primary T1/T0 endpoints
